meta.name: paid-ads-launch
meta.description: Plan and prepare a new paid-media campaign or cross-channel test before it can spend. Use when asked to create, launch, start, set up, or allocate budget to an advertising campaign on any supported platform.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在花钱之前把新广告投放的方案和各渠道预算规划好
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正准备上线新的付费广告或做跨渠道投放测试
copy.tagline_en: Plan a new paid campaign and its channel budgets before any spend
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're about to launch a paid ad campaign or cross-channel test

howto.what: 在花钱之前先做投放前置规划:它会先确认转化目标、预算、落地页等门槛信息,再产出一份可审阅的投放前简报,并只在验证过的渠道上以暂停状态创建广告。
howto.when: 当你要创建、启动或给广告系列分配预算时接管,覆盖 Google、Meta、LinkedIn 等支持的平台;门槛信息不全时它会先追问再规划。

say.text: 帮我规划一个日预算 500 元的 Google Search 拉新投放
say.note: 它会先补全门槛信息再出简报

say.text: 把这份 Meta 投放需求整理成投放前简报
say.note: 产出可审阅的 ready_for_review 简报

say.text: 先创建暂停状态的广告,别激活
say.note: 在验证过的渠道上以暂停状态建好

howto.what_en: Before any spend, it gathers required inputs (conversion goal, budget, landing page) and produces a reviewable preflight brief, then builds campaigns paused on verified platforms only.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to create, launch, or allocate budget to a campaign on supported platforms like Google, Meta, or LinkedIn; if inputs are missing it asks first.

say_en.text: Plan a Google Search campaign for new customers at $500/day
say_en.note: It fills gaps first, then briefs you

say_en.text: Turn this Meta request into a preflight brief
Create the campaign paused, don't activate it
say_en.note: Builds it paused on verified surfaces
